Specification: This module defines core types and helper operators for a task orchestration model resembling SwarmKit task management. It declares abstract constants for nodes, services, task IDs, and a replica bound; defines record types and task lifecycle states; and provides helper operators for state ordering, task identity, and virtual slots. The module contains no variables, actions, temporal formulas, fairness conditions, or PlusCal algorithm.
IfThenElse: IF t.slot = global THEN t.node ELSE t.slot
RecordConstructor:
[
  id : TaskId,
  service : ServiceId,
  status : TaskStatus,
  desired_state : DesiredState,
  node : Node \union {unassigned},
  slot : Slot \union {global}
]
TupleConstructor:
<< new, pending, assigned, accepted,
             preparing, ready, starting,
             running,
             complete, shutdown, failed, rejected,
             remove, orphaned >>
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE i \in DOMAIN order : order[i] = s
